name: Viral 50 USA
content:
Description: Top 50 songs in the USA from the iTunes Top Songs feed. This dataset keeps the historical Viral 50 USA table name for compatibility.

Source: [iTunes Top Songs RSS Feed](https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/topsongs/limit=100/json)

Processing: fetched from the iTunes RSS feed and truncated to the first 50 chart entries

Columns:

* Track Name (string): name of the song
* Artist (string): name of the artist of the song
* Position (numerical): ranking number of the song
